tests.description: Connection and control scopes match the authenticated RuntimeSession.
RuntimeSession resolves exactly one admitted sandbox_slot_key and never accepts a provider-native Sandbox identity.
Only Runtime Gateway creates platform-managed recording state; Sandbox Providers cannot authorize or finalize recordings.
Frames from an older connection generation are rejected.
Reconnect within the resume window replays frames without gaps or duplicates.
Expired resume state directs the client to immutable recording playback.
Sender honors acknowledgement and receive-window limits.
Repeated control command IDs do not repeat side effects.
Recording checkpoints bind channel sequence to WorkOrder work_sequence.
Finalized chunks contain no token, authorization header or registered secret shape.
Unredacted live frames remain memory-bounded and cannot become an ArtifactVersion, database payload or durable queue record.
Gateway restart or reroute increments generation and preserves authorized recovery.
Route lookup cannot resolve another tenant, principal or WorkOrder.
